system.description: Decide how the clone moves: vehicle, teleportation, or innate cloned powers. Choose two from this list, or one from this list and a second from another template. Build from heroes successfully Attacked by Skeeterbots in Scene 1. (1 per DNA-sampled hero of matching archetype.)
system.tactics: Mimic the copied hero; choose two abilities from the listed options, or make one up that mimics something the hero is good at.

system.description: Choose two abilities: Flier: +1 to Attack actions while flying. | Speedster: Hinder two targets with the same roll. | Teleporter: Move from one location to another with up to two allies, then Boost those allies. | Evasive Maneuvers: +2 to damage saves. | Portal Maker: Make a Boost action, then suddenly appear near a target. Immediately Attack using that bonus.
